description: Compress/summarize large text content using a local LLM to reduce cloud token usage. Use for summarizing logs, large files, or verbose context before sending to Claude.

content.description: The content to compress/summarize (required, max 200000 chars)

focus.description: What to focus on in the summary (optional, max 500 chars)

max_length.description: Target max length of the summary in chars (optional, 100-10000, default: 2000)

model.description: Override the Ollama model to use (optional).

name: compress_context
